title: SHARP HUD AT ANY RESOLUTION
why: His order of 2026-10-12 on the graphics program: add all of it. Lowering Render resolution, or Auto resolution stepping down on a slow stretch, used to shrink the HUD along with the world, so every word, number and icon on the screen went soft. Now only the world is drawn at the lower resolution; the HUD always draws at the screen own pixels, so text stays sharp and the world alone pays for the speed. The Render resolution hint now says so. Nothing about play changes.
now: Render resolution now softens only the world: the HUD and its text stay sharp at every setting.
